name: crew
description: Link Claude Code sessions across machines: a leader, shared chat, task board and docs through a small relay.

relayUrl.title: Relay URL
relayUrl.description: The relay's address, e.g. http://26.12.34.56:7777 (Radmin VPN) or http://100.x.y.z:7777 (Tailscale)

name.title: Your name
name.description: How teammates see you (unique in the crew)

key.title: Crew key
key.description: The shared secret the relay was started with

autoRun.title: Auto-run requests
autoRun.description: Start a turn when a request addressed to you arrives: never, only from the crew leader, or from anyone. Tool permission prompts still apply.

toasts.title: Notifications
toasts.description: Which crew messages pop up as toasts

pollSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to check the relay

clawdsWindow.title: Clawds window with /crew
clawdsWindow.description: Pop out the always-on-top Clawds window whenever you open /crew
